Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of the y.
Participant(x, y) ::: x participated in the y.
SixWayTie(y) ::: y is a six-way tie on the leaderboard.
From(x, y) ::: x is from y.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.
AllOnLeaderboardParticipated(y) ::: All people on the leaderboard of y participated in y.
Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, 1992 du Maurier Classic) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participant(steinhauer, 1992 du Maurier Classic) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (SixWayTie(x) ∧ From(x, Belgium)) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
From(descampe, Belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, 1992 du Maurier Classic) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, 1992 du Maurier Classic) → Participant(x, 1992 du Maurier Classic)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
From(descampe, Belgium) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, 1992 du Maurier Classic) ∧ ∃x (SixWayTie(x) ∧ OnLeaderboard(descampe, 1992 du Maurier Classic)) ::: Descampe is in the six-way tie in the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
